in_marathi.name: Lukman
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lukman हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Arabic language, Lukman means 'wise' or 'intelligent'. In Hindu mythology, Lukman is known as the divine architect Vishwakarma's chief advisor. He is the embodiment of wisdom and knowledge.
